mapper.select: SELECT l.* FROM bike_pi_logistics l JOIN bike_pi original ON original.id=l.pi_id JOIN bike_pi requested ON requested.series_id=original.series_id WHERE requested.id=#{piId} ORDER BY l.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_pi_logistics(pi_id,batch_no,carrier,tracking_no,status,shipped_at,remark,created_by,stock_out_batch_id,link_type,shipped_qty_snapshot) VALUES(#{piId},#{request.batchNo},#{request.carrier},#{request.trackingNo},#{request.status},CASE WHEN #{request.status}='SHIPPED' THEN NOW(3) ELSE NULL END, #{request.remark},#{operatorId},#{request.stockOutBatchId},CASE WHEN #{request.stockOutBatchId} IS NULL THEN 'PLAN_UNLINKED' ELSE 'ACTUAL_BATCH' END,#{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_pi_logistics SET batch_no=#{request.batchNo},carrier=#{request.carrier},tracking_no=#{request.trackingNo},status=#{request.status}, shipped_at=CASE WHEN #{request.status}='SHIPPED' THEN NOW(3) ELSE NULL END,remark=#{request.remark},stock_out_batch_id=#{request.stockOutBatchId}, link_type=CASE WHEN #{request.stockOutBatchId} IS NULL THEN 'PLAN_UNLINKED' ELSE 'ACTUAL_BATCH' END,shipped_qty_snapshot=#{quantity},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{request.expectedRevision} AND status IN ('PLANNED','WITHDRAWN')
UPDATE bike_pi_logistics SET status='WITHDRAWN',revoked_at=NOW(3),revoke_reason=#{reason},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision} AND status IN ('PLANNED','SHIPPED')
mapper.select: SELECT r.logistics_id,r.payload_hash FROM bike_pi_logistics_request r JOIN bike_pi p ON p.series_id=r.series_id WHERE p.id=#{piId} AND r.operator_id=#{operatorId} AND r.request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_pi_logistics_request(series_id,operator_id,request_id,payload_hash,logistics_id) SELECT series_id,#{operatorId},#{requestId},#{hash},#{id} FROM bike_pi WHERE id=#{piId}
mapper.select: SELECT revision,action,snapshot,operator_id operatorId,created_at createdAt FROM bike_pi_logistics_history WHERE logistics_id=#{id} ORDER BY revision
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_pi_logistics WHERE stock_out_batch_id=#{batchId} AND id!=#{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_pi_order_link ol ON ol.order_id=so.order_id JOIN bike_pi p ON p.series_id=ol.series_id JOIN bike_pi_logistics l ON l.pi_id=p.id AND l.status='SHIPPED' LEFT JOIN bike_stock_out_batch_item i ON i.stock_out_id=so.id WHERE so.id=#{stockOutId} AND (l.stock_out_batch_id=i.batch_id OR l.stock_out_batch_id IS NULL)

SELECT l.carrier,l.tracking_no,l.status FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_stock_out_batch_item i ON i.stock_out_id=so.id JOIN bike_pi_logistics l ON l.stock_out_batch_id=i.batch_id WHERE so.stock_out_no=#{stockNo} ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 1
